status.summary: Bantamweight contender, #4 in the UFC media-panel rankings (Nov 3, 2026), coming off the first stoppage loss of his career: Song Yadong knocked him out at 1:48 of round 2 in the UFC Shanghai main event (Aug 29, 2026), with Umar a massive favourite. Before that he had rebuilt with clear wins over Mario Bautista (UFC 321, Oct 25, 2025; 30-27 x3) and Deiveson Figueiredo (UFC 324, Jan 24, 2026; 30-27 x3), after his only other loss, a title-fight decision to Merab Dvalishvili at UFC 311 (Jan 18, 2025; 47-48, 46-49, 47-48). He posted from the gym 10 days after the knockout. No UFC bout is booked; his next outing is his Real American Freestyle debut, a freestyle wrestling match (not MMA) against Urijah Faber at RAF Abu Dhabi on Nov 14, 2026. No injury or medical suspension was reported in the sources checked. He is 30. Pro record 20-2; UFC record 8-2 per ufcstats.

style.summary: A Dagestani-style control grappler who wins rounds by landing takedowns and riding long stretches of top position, with a tidy, low-volume kickboxing game at range that leans on body strikes. He is very hard to hit cleanly overall, but he has now been dropped in three of his last six fights. The Song knockout showed the risk of shooting into a counter-puncher who has stopped the first attempts.

moves.notes: Weights are relative within each target group, as src/director.js uses them: head moves sum to 1, body to 1, legs to 1. spinning, knee and elbow are separate rates for occasional specials. fighters.json time-decayed attempt split is 76.8% head, 15.2% body and 8.0% leg (landed 67.1/20.0/13.0). The bantamweight average is 76.2/14.1/9.7, so his head share is average, body is above average and legs are slightly below. Body strikes land at 71%, which suggests kicks and straights at range rather than inside hooks, so bodykick leads at 0.6. That is a judgment from the data, not a scouting page; web pages could not be opened in this pass. The head group is a balanced orthodox split with headkick 0.10 as an unsourced judgment. elbow 0.04 is a small allowance for ground-and-pound from top (15% of his decayed attempts are on the ground). The leg split, spinning and knee are unsourced low defaults.

engine_notes.note: Control is his scoring engine: 23.0 s/min career and 21.9 decayed, about twice the 10.6 s/min league rate. He lands 3.9 takedowns per 15 min (decayed) at 47% accuracy.

Hard to hit cleanly: opponents land only 26.9% of head attempts on him career (28.4% decayed) vs a 37.1% league average. He absorbs 1.97 sig strikes per minute decayed. Despite that, he has absorbed 3 knockdowns in 10 fights, so the low hit rate should not translate into a strong chin in the engine.
Takedown defence is 79% career and decayed (vs 65.7% league), and he gives up only 1.7 s/min of control.

Five-round sample is three bouts (Sandhagen, Dvalishvili and the Song main event, which ended in round 2). Pace 1.00 / 1.75 / 1.46 / 1.91 / 1.12 rests on 10-15 minutes per round, so shrink it toward the prior.
